title: The Subtle Art of Not Giving a F*ck
author: Mark Manson
description: A bold guide to living better by caring less, this 2016 bestseller by blogger Mark Manson challenges conventional self-help tropes.

title: The 48 Laws of Power
author: Robert Greene
description: An influential guide on strategy and manipulation, Robert Greene's bestseller distills power dynamics into 48 essential principles.

title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
author: Gabriel García Márquez
description: A sweeping magical realist saga chronicling the Buendía family in the fictional town of Macondo, this 1967 novel redefined Latin American literature.

title: Rich Dad Poor Dad
author: Robert Kiyosaki & Sharon Lechter
description: First published in 1997, this modern classic promotes financial education through the contrast of two father figures with opposing money mindsets.
